title: fix(plugins): release predecessor registries after replacement
body:
<!-- stack-landing-complete:start -->
**Landed:** merged into `main` as `36e07b8f00243891da8649812863c8cf3ba95349` on September 16, 2026. [Required CI passed on the final PR head](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35062781371/job/104690923988). All five stack layers are merged; [final receipts and before/after proof](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-00-landing-summary-md). The accepted partial repair boundary is unchanged: ESM forced-GC growth remains 36.65 MiB against the 32 MiB limit.
<!-- stack-landing-complete:end -->

## What Problem This Solves

An escaped capability resolver retained the loader scope and its previous plugin registry after replacement.

## User Impact

The live replacement can retain its prepared capability facts without retaining the chain of retired registries.

This is one layer of a partial memory repair: the combined ESM forced-GC endurance result is still **36.65 MiB against a 32 MiB limit (failed)**.

## Why This Change Was Made

Create the resolver outside the loader lexical scope. Route the companion runtime-registry tests through the required host-process lane.

## Evidence

Landing CI exposed a Reef test teardown bug: native reset preceded temporary-file deletion without draining async database admissions. Both fixtures now await the existing lifecycle close. The real Linux SQLite/inode probe changed from **511 failures to zero** under the same 511 inode reuses; the complete Reef file passed **30/30** locally. No production changes, timeout increases or relaxed assertions. Local extension lint could not run through the borrowed-dependency guard; current hosted CI remains required. [Reef cleanup proof](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-reef-cleanup-proof-md).

The combined plugin source passed **356/356 tests across 18 files** before this test-only cleanup; every production byte remains identical. [Integration results](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-final-integration-proof-md).

The four remaining plugin layers were refreshed onto main `08584b3d34c526ad438b39b32931a64a6c61a992`. Every authored plugin-layer added/removed line is unchanged. Temporary Goal-test, planner-fixture and chat-renderer corrections were removed because main now owns their repairs: [planner fixture](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149726), [Goal read reuse and UI cleanup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149697). The three files now exactly match main. The original stricter Goal bound passes all12 cases; removing canonical entry reuse still fails at four reads against its three-read limit. Fresh hosted CI is required for the refreshed heads. [Refresh proof and identities](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-final-base-refresh-md).

With the independent cached-error repair applied, the predecessor-collection regression still failed; after this repair all 18 retention cases passed. The host-process routing correction separately passed 33 registry tests. Five live CJS replacements removed the observed resolver/predecessor retaining paths.

Proof source: `6320346a6d281d4ab570cd67b241ec5d9a74ced8`; the originally published stack top `14a29985cfbc1b6f5e379b225ae7c00078061c16` had the identical Git tree (`bcdb4a87fb86add0a49982acf26af4568056f61b`). The source-built live runs completed all four 20-warmup/500-measured lanes with functional checks passing and stable Gateway PID/socket. Real CLI install/reinstall auto-application and a separate physical shutdown/relaunch also passed. The 500-update trigger was source edits plus explicit `plugins.reload`; HTTP/tool checks were sampled, with full per-update tuples verified in the short diagnostics.

[Layer proof and reproduction commands](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-02-capability-resolver-md) · [Before/after log excerpts](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-historical-test-log-excerpts-md) · [Live reload/restart measurements](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-live-proof-summary-json) · [Fresh review and commit provenance](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-fresh-review-md).

Fresh publication validation: P0–P2 cumulative review found no actionable defects. At publication, the stack plus main `b036baa80649` passed **99 tests across 11 files, zero failed/skipped**, including cache, registry-retention and state-lease owner/sibling coverage. The first integration attempt lacked package-local dependency links; the same command passed after restoring the existing links without an install or source changes. This combined-tree check supplements the exact-source build and live evidence above.

Landing follow-up: two test-only corrections now distinguish retained task bytes from Vite source-map text and bundled companion reuse from installed-plugin capture. The paired reproductions passed **36/36** lifecycle tests and **8/8** companion cases; both scoped P0–P2 reviews and full changed-file gates passed. These follow-up commits change tests only; the five reviewed production patches are preserved. [CI repair proof and commands](https://gist.github.com/Patrick-Erichsen/8ccf64da00f2486dcb05ebf0adc3e711#file-ci-repair-proof-md). Those original test repairs remain in their owning layers; their historical results retain their source identities.

<details>
<summary>Scope and limitations</summary>

- Earlier whole-session shared-OCM isolation failed; later private-store cleanup and named-epoch peer continuity passed separately. The initiating writer was not established.
- Test counts from overlapping historical suites are not additive. No real external channel account or universal plugin compatibility claim.
- Production +10/−1 (net +9); tests/support +100/−3; docs +0/−0. The factory establishes a distinct lexical owner so escaped callbacks cannot capture loader options.
- No new configuration, public protocol or persistent-store contract.

</details>
